challenge: Execution of multiple dome-shaped sports halls requiring accurate curved ZIP panel coordination, structural alignment, waterproofing continuity, and visually consistent architectural finishing across all roof structures.
sipanel_solution: SIPANEL developed an engineered ZIP panel roofing system optimized for curved dome geometry, waterproofing integration, and multi-structure installation coordination.
engineering_decision: Engineering teams prepared coordinated shop drawings, curved ZIP panel layouts, waterproofing details, and installation sequencing strategies to maintain dome symmetry, drainage continuity, and installation precision across all three halls.
execution_detail: Installation followed controlled curved-surface execution procedures, alignment checkpoints, fastening verification, and coordinated sealing workflows to ensure accurate dome geometry and long-term weather protection.
measured_result: Successful delivery of three structurally coordinated dome-shaped wrestling halls with reliable ZIP panel roof performance, clean architectural integration, and controlled installation quality.
primary_message: Engineered ZIP panel roofing systems designed for curved sports structures and long-term waterproof performance.

metrics.execution_focus: Curved geometry precision and waterproofing control
